We have template details. The mapped_rxn shows reactants and product. The product is after >>. Let's parse mapped_rxn: '[CH:14]#[C:15][Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19].O=[C:5]([C:3]([O:2][CH3:1])=[O:4])[CH2:6][CH2:7][c:8]1[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]1>>[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]'

So product SMILES: [CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]

We need to remove atom mapping to get canonical SMILES. Let's construct: CH3O C(=O) C1( /CH=CH/ c2ccccc2 ) C= C1 Si(CH3)(CH3)CH3? Wait need to interpret.

Simplify: The product appears to be an ester of something with a silyl alkyne? Actually product includes Si attached to alkyne carbon.

Let's try to generate SMILES without mapping: CH3O C(=O) C1( /CH=CH/ c2ccccc2 ) C= C1 Si(CH3)(CH3)CH3

So SMILES: COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C= C1[Si](C)(C)C? Need correct syntax: [Si](C)(C)C is trimethylsilyl. So final: COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C=C1[Si](C)(C)C

But there is also a double bond to Si? Actually [CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]... So carbon 14 double bonded to carbon 15 which is part of ring? Wait ring numbering: C5 is carbonyl carbon? Let's trust approximate.

We also have precursors from earlier: ['C#C[Si](C)(C)C', 'COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1'].

Thus target product is likely: COC(=O)C1(/C=C/CCc1ccccc1)C=C1[Si](C)(C)C? Not exactly.

But we can construct route JSON: root molecule is product SMILES (we need correct). Use reaction node with template_id 1914386 and children precursors.

We should verify step using verify_step tool: need molecule_smiles (target), template_id (SMARTS? It expects template in SMARTS format). We have retro_smarts_template. Provide that. Precursors list as above.

Let's call verify_step.
We need retro_smarts_template from get_template result: it's '[C;D1;H3:9]-[#14:10](-[C;D1;H3:11])(-[C;D1;H3:12])-[C;H0;D3;+0:13]1=[CH;D2;+0:14]-[C;H0;D4;+0:1]-1(/[CH;D2;+0:2]=[CH;D2;+0:3]/[c:4])-[C:5](=[O;D1;H0:6])-[#8:7]-[C;D1;H3:8]>>O=[C;H0;D3;+0:1](-[CH2;D2;+0:2]-[CH2;D2;+0:3]-[c:4])-[C:5](=[O;D1;H0:6])-[#8:7]-[C;D1;H3:8].[C;D1;H3:9]-[#14:10](-[C;D1;H3:11])(-[C;D1;H3:12])-[C;H0;D2;+0:13]#[CH;D1;+0:14]'

But verify_step expects template_id as SMARTS? It says template_id (str) Retrosynthetic template in SMARTS format. So we can pass retro_smarts_template.

Now need target SMILES. Let's generate using mapping removal: product part after >>: [CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]

Remove mapping numbers and brackets: CH3 O C(=O) C1(/CH=CH/c2ccccc2)C= C1[Si](CH3)(CH3)CH3

SMILES: COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C=C1[Si](C)(C)C

Let's verify with tool.
